name: Volkswagen Group / CARIAD
sub: ID.Buzz robotaxis on Uber in LA through MOIA
leadership: Oliver Blume, Group CEO; Peter Bosch, CEO of CARIAD
about: Large OEM group whose software unit CARIAD has changed strategy after ending their Bosch automated-driving alliance.
model: Vehicle manufacturing, software-defined vehicle programs, platform and mobility services.
deployment: ID. Buzz / MOIA autonomy efforts, Mobileye/Valeo L2+ work, CARIAD/Bosch historical alliance.
metrics: Reuters reported CARIAD and Bosch ended their automated-driving tie-up in July 2026.
signal: MOIA's autonomous ID.Buzz (Mobileye Drive, 27-sensor suite, built in Hanover) is live on Uber in Los Angeles with safety drivers, 100+ vehicles and commercial service targeted by end of 2026, fully driverless in 2027.

sources.title: Volkswagen Scales Back Cariad's Role, Turns to Rivian and Xpeng for Software Development
